pages.text: Becoming a neko grants you not just a cute appearance, but also $(#FF69B4)four special abilities$()：$(thing)Neko Stealth$(), $(thing)Claw Climbing$(), $(thing)Creeper Affinity$(), and $(thing)Neko Pounce$().$(br2)Stealth and climbing consume $(thing)Neko Energy$(); pounce costs no energy and only has a short cooldown. Managing your energy wisely is a must-learn skill for every neko!$(br2)$(#FFB6C1)Nekos aren't just cute — we're quite capable!$()

pages.title: 🐾 Neko Stealth
pages.text: Activate via the $(#FF69B4)Skill Roulette$()（Z key）— select the "Neko Stealth" option. Once active, $(thing)crouch$()（hold Shift）to enter stealth mode.$(br2)$(li)Moving: $(#FF69B4)0.8 energy/tick$()$(li)Standing still: $(#FF69B4)0.2 energy/tick$()$(br2)$(thing)Attacking$() breaks stealth immediately, triggering a $(#FF69B4)100 tick$()（5s）cooldown. Running out of energy also disables it.$(br2)The HUD shows your current stealth status — green "Active" or gray "Idle".

pages.title: 🧗 Claw Climbing
pages.text: Press against a wall and hold $(#FF69B4)R$() to climb like a real cat!$(br2)How to use:$(li)Stand next to any solid block wall$(li)Hold R to start climbing$(li)$(thing)W/S$() keys to move up/down$(li)Release R to stop climbing$(br2)Energy cost:$(li)Climbing up: $(#FF69B4)0.8 energy/tick$()$(li)Moving down: $(#FF69B4)0.3 energy/tick$()$(li)Hanging still: $(#FF69B4)0.1 energy/tick$()

pages.title: Climbing Tips
pages.text: While climbing, you gain these advantages:$(br2)$(li)$(thing)Ignore gravity$() — you won't fall$(li)$(thing)Zero fall damage$() — even if you run out of energy mid-climb$(li)$(thing)Full stillness$() — release movement keys to rest on the wall$(br2)Great for:$(li)Scaling mountains without building$(li)Exploring ravines by going straight down/up$(li)Fell into a deep pit? Climb out!$(br2)$(#FFB6C1)With cat claws, terrain is no obstacle!$()

pages.title: 💥 Creeper Affinity
pages.text: This is a $(#FF69B4)passive ability$() — no activation needed, it just works as long as you're a neko.$(br2)When a $(item)Creeper$() has a neko within $(#FF69B4)7 blocks$(), it will $(thing)cancel its explosion$() — the fuse resets to zero.$(br2)Unlike vanilla cats/ocelots: creepers $(#FF69B4)won't run away$(). They'll just stand there dumbly, neither blowing up nor fleeing.

pages.title: 🐈 Neko Pounce
pages.text: Hold $(#FF69B4)Sneak (Shift)$() and $(#FF69B4)Sprint (Ctrl)$() together to charge up, then $(thing)release Sneak$() to launch yourself along your $(#FF69B4)look direction$().$(br2)$(li)Max charge is $(#FF69B4)2 seconds$(); anything under $(#FF69B4)0.25s$() counts as a misclick$(li)A charge bar appears where the XP bar normally is$(li)Direction is purely your crosshair: look up to fly, straight ahead to dash, down to dive$(li)Wind-charge sound on launch, dust on landing$(br2)Only $(thing)Nekos$() can use it, and you must be standing on the ground — it won't fire in water, while gliding, or while riding.

pages.title: Pounce Numbers & Tips
pages.text: What pounce gives you:$(br2)$(li)For $(#FF69B4)3 seconds$() after launch, melee damage ×$(#FF69B4)(2 + 0.1 × Neko level)$(); ends early on the first hit$(li)$(#FF69B4)Complete fall-damage immunity$() during the pounce and on the landing tick$(li)You automatically take a $(thing)swimming/prone$() pose in the air, standing upright again on landing$(li)Only a $(#FF69B4)0.5s$() cooldown, and no Neko Energy cost$(br2)Impulse = $(#FF69B4)1.35 × charge progress × √(1.5 × (1 + 0.02 × level))$() blocks/tick — longer charge and higher level mean farther and higher.$(br2)$(#FFB6C1)Ground dash, wall-hop, or face-first dive — your crosshair decides how you pounce!$()

pages.title: Energy Management Tips
pages.text: Stealth and climbing rely on $(thing)Neko Energy$()（pounce costs none, it only has a 0.5s cooldown）. Manage it well:$(br2)$(li)Always carry some $(item)Catnip$() — quick 30 energy boost$(li)Keep a $(item)Neko Energy Battery$() in your bag — automatic buffering$(li)Get close with neko NPCs — $(thing)cuddling$() restores energy for both sides$(li)Stealth + climbing in a row is very energy-hungry — pace yourself$(br2)$(#FFB6C1)Energy is a neko's second life — cherish it well, meow~$()
